title: Scale-Induced Semantic Shift in Visual Prompt Injection Against VLMs and Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.16744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual content in multimedia systems may be resized, compressed, or re-rendered before it is interpreted by a vision-language model. We study a security failure mode in which these transformations change the machine-readable semantics of an image: a textual instruction is not recovered at a $512\times512$ presentation resolution under our evaluation protocol but becomes recoverable after aggressive downsampling. We formulate this behavior as Scale-Induced Semantic Shift (SISS) and develop a closed-loop black-box framework that combines dual-scale verification, selective self-hardening, shallow-layer low-rank adaptation, and pixel-space noise regularization. On a fixed 300-case benchmark, the third SISS refinement round obtains a $58.75\%$ average attack success rate across four closed-source vision-language models, compared with $41.08\%$ for the strongest generation baseline. translated_title: 面向视觉语言模型与网页代理的视觉提示注入中的尺度诱导语义偏移
translated_abstract: 多媒体系统中的视觉内容在视觉语言模型进行解读之前，可能会经历缩放、压缩或重新渲染等处理。我们研究了一种安全失效模式：这些变换会改变图像的机器可读语义——在我们的评估协议下，一条文本指令在512×512的呈现分辨率下无法被识别出来，但在激进下采样之后却变得可以被识别。我们将这种行为形式化为“尺度诱导语义偏移”，并开发了一个闭环黑盒框架，该框架结合了双尺度验证、选择性自我强化、浅层低秩适配以及像素空间噪声正则化。在一个固定的300个案例基准上，第三轮SISS迭代优化在四个闭源视觉语言模型上取得了58.75%的平均攻击成功率，相比之下最强的生成式基线仅为41.08%。一项受控扫描实验将这一效应的范围限定于激进压缩的情形。
tldr: 该论文揭示了一种新型安全威胁“尺度诱导语义偏移”（SISS）：图像经过激进压缩下采样后，原本无法被识别的提示注入指令反而变得可被视觉语言模型读取，并提出了结合双尺度验证、选择性自我强化与低秩适配的闭环黑盒攻击框架，在四个闭源模型上实现了58.75%的攻击成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies Scale-Induced Semantic Shift (SISS), a novel vulnerability where aggressive downsampling makes hidden prompt injection instructions readable to vision-language models, and proposes a closed-loop black-box framework combining dual-scale verification, selective self-hardening, and low-rank adaptation, achieving a 58.75% average attack success rate on four closed-source VLMs.
